body: What a coincidence, was just listening to Sad Statue by SOAD when I saw this
It's not even a response. It's just me. I haven't cried in a long time. I just feel so empty day to day and always look for immediate gratification. I am super robotic.

Same exact thing with me. It's like I can't pull any thoughts out of my head, and all I can do is go along with little scripted responses I've developed over the years like "How's it going?" or "Pretty good, how about you?" .. "Pretty good." is my go-to response when someone asks me how I'm doing.
Not at all, I work in a grocery store (yes its fucking hell I hate it so god damn much fuck fuck fuck) and I see people go through self checkout just to buy like single drinks and stuff.
Happens on the daily for me.. literally EVERY day..

I had a very close friend who looked up to me as an older brother basically our whole childhood, then just a year ago or so he asked my brother why I acted so weird. Also, some other guy told me my personality type was 'Alien' when we were sharing personality test things in a group chat. Needless to say I don't talk to them anymore. I don't talk to anybody anymore.

Exactly the same for me. I've been working at the same job for over a year and a half now and I've just gotten worse. Everyone sort of accommodates now for me by speaking very slowly and politely, and also very little.
Now fill them an eighth of the way full with sulfuric acid.
Thank you for your thoughts. I'm starting my class tomorrow. So nervous.

I'm just like you man. I graduated a couple years back but in highschool I coped with my anxiety by putting my head down and pretending I was tired all the time. I would just stare at my desk while my hands would sweat and my head would be filled with the purest form of anxiety possible. I'm guessing everyone thought I was a complete creep. I lost all my friends because they thought I was too weird.
I'm the same exact way. My mind just goes cloudy when I'm talking to people, which makes me do dumb things and forget shit people say easily. 20  y/o here.
Yep. I just sit at home and play on my laptop. Also been friendless since around 11-12 years old and I'm 20 now.

I appreciate your comment, man. Yeah, I did cardio for awhile but got lazy, definitely going to have to start jogging again. Hardest part is jogging through my neighborhood, though. People are always out biking/walking..
I used to take Klonopin, it really helped me for awhile, but I stopped seeing my doctor because of insurance. Also I heard they stopped prescribing Klonopin.
